text:
olivia: Heads up — saw a perf regression in the autotuner rollout. Short-chat workload (seq<=32) now picks the 'tensorcore-tiling' kernel on SM86 machines and latency p50 went up ~18%.

perf-bot: perf-alert: p50 increased 18% on staging/qa-rt-2 for model gpt-3ish, run 2026-03-15T10:12Z

olivia: Profile dump attached. Kernel selection trace shows device_probe mapping sm=86 -> tc capable, then runtime picks tc_tiled_kv_v2 even for seq=16.

[selection_log]
hw_sig: sm=86, driver=542, tensor_cores=1
cap_flags: bf16=1 fp8=0 tc=1
seq=16 batch=4 -> chosen_kernel: tc_tiled_kv_v2
latency_ms: 72.4 (baseline 61.3)
[end log]

jamal: hmm. could be the driver exposing TC but not the right bf16 fast path. We recently added 'tc-tile-v2' which assumes bf16_fastmma. If bf16 math is slower on that driver, it's a regression.

leo: Is this coupled to KV cache warmup? Short seqs + small batches can cause KV cache churn and reinit which skews kernel microbench numbers.

anya: Repro I used: 
```
python infra/perf/run_profile.py --model=gpt-neoX --seq=16 --batch=4 --repeat=100
```
Same ~15-20% p50 reg on sm86 driver 542.

infra-bot: deploy-note: autotuner v0.9.2 -> v0.9.3 rolled to staging at 2026-03-15T09:50Z

jamal: quick mitigation idea: add a handshake/version + capability sanity microbench in device_probe. If tc==1 but bf16 latency > cpu_fallback_threshold, mark bf16_fast=0 and force generic_kv for short sequences.

olivia: agree. Also gate kernel choice in router by sequence-length: prefer 'small-seq generic_kv' for seq<32 unless the microbench certifies tc path is beneficial.

leo: I'll add a tiny microprobe that runs 5 iters of the tiled kernel on device init and sets cap_flags.bf16_fast=1 only if jitter < 10%. If it fails, clear flag. Cheap and fast.

anya: Also adjust batching heuristic: for seq<=32 bias toward larger batch affinity so we avoid tiny batches that trigger kv reinit. Proposed param: min_batch_for_kvcache=8 (tunable).

jamal: Action items:
- leo: microprobe + cap flag (owner) — target: EOD staging
- olivia: router gating config + canary rollout
- anya: batching tweak + perf test updates
- infra: pin affected pool to driver 541 until vendor patch

olivia: tests: add unit that simulates sm86 driver 542 with tc=1 and bf16_slow and assert kernel fallback path chosen for seq<32.

anya: I'll open PRs for heuristic and tests and post links here shortly.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Let's keep the canary narrow. :thumbsup:
